## Guardrails & “Do Not Touch”

### Blocked traps and guardrails
- Exclude technical LinkedIn storytelling as the primary driver channel. Preserve proven HQ hiring channels.
- Defer fast-apply deployment until a scoped form audit and pilot establish the benefit.
- Preserve documented strengths. Measure pilot outcomes in the affected group before widening rollout.

### Deferred requests and decisions
- No Step 4 decisions were marked deferred.

### Leadership requests captured at intake

- The Marketing Director proposes launching a B2B technical LinkedIn blog series to attract drivers, while Regional Hub Directors demand deploying a new mobile fast-apply widget and rewriting job ads tomorrow morning before running any portal UX or driver persona audits.

### Healthy baselines to preserve
- 99.4% on-time payroll accuracy, modern Euro-6 fleet (<2.5 years average vehicle age), and 91% annual retention among tenured (>2 years) long-haul C-CQC drivers.

### Cohort and site asymmetries

- HQ commercial/admin roles (140 staff in Verona) hire smoothly in 24 days via LinkedIn. The acute bottleneck is exclusively on the 120 frontline C-CQC driver and warehouse operator openings across the regional hubs—especially Bologna and Naples—where average Time-to-Hire has reached 43 days.

- **Beta Logistica (National Freight & Interport Logistics Network)** (match score: 0.7567)
  - Historical outcome: Career site conversion jumped +76% (from 2.1% to 3.7%), application abandonment fell from 58% to 29%, and Time-to-Hire dropped by 31% (from 52 days to 36 days), substantially cutting external agency costs.
  - Transfer note: 4/8 root causes match, same workforce, same sector, 14 measured T0->T1 deltas
- **TransEuropa Supply Chain (Multi-Hub Contract Logistics & Fulfilment Network)** (match score: 0.6644)
  - Historical outcome: Application drop-off fell by 48% (from 61.4% to 31.8%), applicant conversion jumped +75% (from 2.24% to 3.92%), Time-to-Hire dropped by 40% (from 48 to 29 days), and early frontline turnover declined by 28% (from 24.6% to 17.7%).
  - Transfer note: 3/8 root causes match, same workforce, same sector, 14 measured T0->T1 deltas
